meta.title: Exploring HOI AN 🇻🇳 // Cooking Class, Bamboo Baskets, & Banh Mi
meta.description:
We made it to the beautiful city of Hoi An, Vietnam! One of the best cities to visit in Vietnam, Hoi An is home to wonderful foods such as Banh Mi, exciting cooking classes, and of course the best for tailoring. Hoi A travel guide with the best things to do in this historic city! #vietnam #hoian #travelguide 

🍳 We booked our eco-cooking class and basket boat tour here (use code LAURENJASONKLOOK for 5% off):
https://www.klook.com/activity/1603-eco-cooking-class-hoi-an/?aid=39554
🚗 For your $13 private transfer from the Da Nang Airport to your accommodation in Hoi An, book here: https://www.klook.com/airport-transfers/?aid=39554

Join us as we take on the historical city of Hoi An by eating and cooking our way through! The best thing to do in Hoi An is truly by tasting all of the city’s delicacies and roaming through the old town throughout day and night. Hoi An’s colorful lanterns light up the streets and so do the floating flames along the peaceful canal every single night! You can’t miss the iconic bamboo basket boat ride and if you love Vietnamese food, an eco-cooking class is the way to learn how to make Vietnamese dishes yourself super easily!
